That zero had two readings and they are opposite news, so it was probed rather than assumed -- a twelve-effect program on the walker completes at the default, is REFUSED L4009 at a ceiling of 7, and completes again at 20. The ceiling is live; the zero is a fact about the CORPUS, which no lang program pushes past seven effects. So this is the one limit with no accidental cover underneath it at all.

why: BOTH CELLS ANCHOR ON LITERALS, and that is the whole mechanism rather than a style choice. The
cell above them compares resolvePins' output to PIN_DEFAULTS -- expected and actual drawn from the
SAME source -- so it cannot see that source move, and a mutation on the table SURVIVES it. That
survivor is what these mutations exist to convert into a kill. Deriving either expected side from
GRADED FROM pins.smoke.ts, which imports ../src/pins.js relatively. The same mutations aimed
through implementations/runtime would sit unread: that suite resolves @cotal-ai/lang to `dist`.
